rationale: Post-contingency base case (l13 out, l14 open) overloads l12 at 100 MW (133% of 75 MW). Opening any single branch (l23, l24, or l34) leaves l12 at 100 MW, still overloaded. Closing the normally-open tie l14 redistributes flow so that l12 drops to ~70.7 MW (94.3%), all other lines remain within rating, the network stays connected, and only one corrective action is used.
